contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

projectId.description: Stable id of the project the user is working in (server-assigned).

sourceSystem.description: Source-of-record identity for the project context when it is synchronized from an external system (e.g. `bim-ifc`, `erp`); absent for AISE-native contexts.

updatedAt.description: Instant the server produced this context snapshot.

userRole.description: The requesting user's role in this project (server-stated, open vocabulary; advisory well-known values: owner, admin, engineer, reviewer, field-operator, observer). Carried verbatim; never reinterpreted by the adapter.
